summary: HF Foods Group Inc. filed an 8-K reporting completion of its acquisition of Searay Foods Inc. and Morgan Foods Inc. (Canadian wholesale distributors) on August 31, 2026. Pursuant to a Securities Purchase Agreement dated July 17, 2026, as amended August 27, 2026, HF Foods' subsidiaries acquired 100% of the sellers' equity for aggregate base consideration of CAD$47,921,740 — approximately 5x baseline Adjusted EBITDA of CAD$9,556,348 plus CAD$140,000 — paid as CAD$38,365,392 cash and 1,701,871 HF Foods shares valued at USD$4.00 per share. Sellers may receive contingent earnout payments based on EBITDA targets over 2-3 years post-closing; the amendment subordinates earnouts to credit facilities, provides SOFR+2% interest on deferred payments, waives certain third-party consents at closing, and adds uncapped indemnification. Watch for earnout achievement and integration execution as risk-arb considerations.
